purpose: Find the intervention reproducibility frontier of source-only coherent groups and size-matched random groups
group_rule: For each of the160 frozen source anchors, rank other source-eligible atoms by positive normalized source contribution covariance. Nested top sizes1/4/16/64; controls keep anchor and fixed-hash random remaining eligible atoms. No target choice of source group.
budget: <=30minutes16GBGPU/CPU,<2GB local output; cached same five weights/codes,0newLM/training/data
